_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json (which is gitignored) and fill in any keys you have. Every key is optional — sources without a configured key simply report 'available: false, reason: API key not configured' instead of crashing. Nine sources need no key at all: NASA, Library of Congress, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Art Institute of Chicago, Cleveland Museum of Art, Victoria & Albert Museum, Wikimedia Commons, Internet Archive (curated collections) and BnF Gallica.
SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY: get a free key at https://api.data.gov/signup/
EUROPEANA_API_KEY: get a free wskey at https://apis.europeana.eu/
NARA_API_KEY: get a free key at https://api.data.gov/signup/
RIJKSMUSEUM_API_KEY: get a free key at https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/register
